   - The error message printed upon timeout now includes the actual timeout value, which is adjusted to include the additional time spent polling (`hwrm_total_timeout(i) + j`).

The changes in `bnxt_hwrm.h` and `bnxt_hwrm.c` are directly related. The increase in the `HWRM_VALID_BIT_DELAY_USEC` constant in the header file sets a new maximum polling duration for the DMA completion check. The corresponding changes in the source file implement this new delay by adjusting the polling loop to handle the increased wait time more effectively. Additionally, the error reporting is enhanced to reflect the actual timeout experienced during the polling, providing better diagnostics for potential issues. Overall, these modifications aim to improve the robustness of the firmware message response handling in the driver.
